n3a9f005a83.headline: Coles hits back, blames inflation for prices going up
n3a9f005a83.summary: Coles says inflation drove price rises during its "down down" campaign and denies misleading customers. The company is contesting a case over the claims.
n3a9f005a83.why: Coles is one of Australia's two largest supermarket chains, so pricing practices and legal challenges affect consumer spending and regulatory scrutiny.

n6da06975f6.headline: Trainline dips after boss reveals plans to quit
n6da06975f6.summary: Trainline shares dropped as much as 7 on Wednesday morning after the boss revealed plans to quit. The FTSE 250 company is listed in London.
n6da06975f6.why: Trainline is a UK online rail ticket seller, and leadership changes can affect investor confidence in mid-cap companies.

nb77f60db0a.headline: Georgia House adopts Kemp's income tax cut
nb77f60db0a.summary: The Georgia state House passed Governor Brian Kemp's income tax rate cut in a mostly party-line vote, leaving the measure halfway to approval in the Legislature.
nb77f60db0a.why: State income tax changes affect household disposable income and state revenue, which matter for regional consumer spending and municipal bond credit.

n9ec488d534.headline: Institutional investors drive demand in Kenya state oil pipeline’s IPO, adviser says
n9ec488d534.summary: The lead adviser said institutional investors drove an oversubscribed IPO for a 65% stake in Kenya Pipeline Company, with the offer running January 19 to February 24.
n9ec488d534.why: Kenya Pipeline Company operates the country's main fuel pipeline network, so its listing matters for East African fuel logistics and state asset sales.

n3ac6b87893.headline: Ukraine War, Day 1,462: Trump Administration Abstains on UN Vote Supporting Kyiv v. Russia's Invasion
n3ac6b87893.summary: The Trump administration abstained on a UN resolution supporting Kyiv, marking the fourth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
n3ac6b87893.why: Western policy on the Ukraine war shapes sanctions, aid and reconstruction expectations that affect European and Ukrainian assets.

naa86b61795.headline: 'Rise on the horizon': inflation fuels rate hike fears
naa86b61795.summary: A small increase in underlying inflation has led to growing expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia will lift the cash rate. The report is based on a regional news source.
naa86b61795.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and asset valuations across the economy.

n100123d6cf.headline: India’s EV sector draws ₹2.23 lakh cr investment, faces 80% funding gap: IEEFA
n100123d6cf.summary: India's EV sector mobilised ₹2.23 lakh crore between 2020 and 2025, just 18% of the ₹12.5 lakh crore needed by 2030, according to an IEEFA report. EV financing costs range from 15% to 33%.
n100123d6cf.why: The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis is a think tank whose reports shape policy debate on energy transition financing in emerging markets.

n2b10f9d28a.headline: Trump hails 'golden age' as US voters sour on economy
n2b10f9d28a.summary: Donald Trump broke the record for the longest State of the Union speech while claiming a golden age for the US. Voters are reported to be souring on the economy.
n2b10f9d28a.why: Public sentiment on the economy shapes US policy direction and political risk for investors. The State of the Union is the President's annual address to Congress.

n559b6d89a9.headline: Uncertainty Impacting the Markets - Commodities Southeast AgNET
n559b6d89a9.summary: Market volatility is rising near the CME Group in Chicago, with the CBOE Volatility Index climbing amid tariff-related uncertainty. The source article is brief on specifics.
n559b6d89a9.why: The CBOE Volatility Index measures expected near-term S&P 500 volatility and is a widely watched gauge of investor fear. Tariff uncertainty often drives sharp swings in it.

impacts.name: CBOE Volatility Index
impacts.why: Rising volatility reflects higher expected market swings amid tariff uncertainty.

ncc680da6e5.headline: Firm sets up Singapore trading arm
ncc680da6e5.summary: A Cebu-based listed fuel distributor has approved the creation of a wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore. The move is part of its long-term vertical integration strategy.
ncc680da6e5.why: Fuel distributors buy and sell refined petroleum products, and trading hubs such as Singapore are key centres for oil supply. Vertical integration can shift costs and margins across the supply chain.

n56572ddd82.headline: Oil Hovers Near Seven-month Highs Ahead of US-Iran Talks
n56572ddd82.summary: Brent rose to $70.83 a barrel and WTI to $65.67 as investors weighed possible US-Iran conflict that could disrupt supply. A large build in US crude inventories weighed on sentiment.
n56572ddd82.why: Brent and WTI are the main global crude benchmarks, widely used to price oil across energy markets. Their moves feed into fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.
n56572ddd82.why_moved: Fears that US-Iran military conflict could disrupt supply pushed prices higher, partly offset by a large rise in US crude stockpiles.

ndc3629913b.headline: Valens Semiconductor Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
ndc3629913b.summary: Valens Semiconductor, a high-performance connectivity chip company listed on the NYSE as VLN, reported results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025. The release contained no further detail in the input.
ndc3629913b.why: Valens designs chips for automotive and industrial connectivity, so its results indicate demand in those markets. Quarterly reporting is a key signal for small-cap semiconductor investors.

n7f779afc02.headline: ImmunityBio (IBRX) Reports 700% Revenue Surge Driven by Rapid ANKTIVA Adoption
n7f779afc02.summary: ImmunityBio reported 2025 net product revenue for ANKTIVA of $113 million, a 700% year-over-year increase. Unit sales rose 750% over the same period.
n7f779afc02.why: ImmunityBio is a US biotechnology company whose ANKTIVA immunotherapy is its lead commercial product.

n1a32341b47.headline: Pipeline repairs trigger sharp Oregon gas price surge
n1a32341b47.summary: A brief shutdown of the Olympic Pipeline triggered sharp fuel price increases across Oregon. The statewide average for regular gasoline rose 22 cents to $3.91.
n1a32341b47.why: Pipelines carry most refined fuel to regional markets, so outages quickly affect local gasoline prices.

n0c22ec7e56.headline: Nvidia and other tech stocks lead Wall Street higher
n0c22ec7e56.summary: U.S. stocks rose on Wednesday, erasing their losses for the week so far. Nvidia and other technology companies led the gains.
n0c22ec7e56.why: Nvidia is a leading designer of AI chips, and its share price moves often influence broader US equity indexes and tech sector sentiment.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: Nvidia led the gains in technology shares on Wednesday.

n0c22ec7e56.why_moved: Gains in Nvidia and other technology companies lifted US stocks, which had been down for the week so far.

nc63e710857.headline: Nvidia delivers another quarter of stellar growth
nc63e710857.summary: Nvidia reported another quarter of outstanding growth, with chief executive Jensen Huang citing demand for the company's products. Further details were not included in the source excerpt.
nc63e710857.why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, so its quarterly results are closely watched as a gauge of demand for AI data-center hardware.

n6656600fc2.headline: Friedrich Merz China Visit: ‘Great potential for growth’: Germany’s Friedrich Merz seeks closer China ties, presses Beijing on Ukraine
n6656600fc2.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called for closer cooperation with China and fairer trade rules. He also urged Beijing to use its influence on Ukraine.
n6656600fc2.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy and China is one of its biggest trading partners, so bilateral trade terms matter for industrial exporters.

n93b26508da.headline: 'Dumbest option': top economist slams housing tax break
n93b26508da.summary: A top economist criticised a housing tax break and urged the government to make a clean break on any changes to taxes on investment properties. The article calls the option the 'dumbest'.
n93b26508da.why: Tax treatment of investment property shapes housing demand, rental supply and household borrowing in Australia.

n0deaa92841.headline: 'Rise on the horizon': inflation fuels rate hike fears
n0deaa92841.summary: A small increase in underlying inflation has led to growing expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia will lift the cash rate. The report describes the move as a rise on the horizon.
n0deaa92841.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which anchors borrowing costs across the economy and drives pricing for bonds, the Australian dollar and bank equities.

ndaa5398ada.headline: Yangzijiang Shipbuilding posts 24.6% rise in H2 profit to 4.5 billion yuan
ndaa5398ada.summary: Yangzijiang Shipbuilding posted a 24.6% rise in second-half profit to 4.5 billion yuan. It proposed a final dividend of S$0.20 per share.
ndaa5398ada.why: Yangzijiang is a major Chinese shipbuilder listed in Singapore, and its earnings reflect global newbuild vessel demand and shipyard margins.

n53ee73a944.headline: Malaysian fuel prices Feb 26-March 4, 2026 - up 5 sen; RON95 to RM2.59, RON97 to RM3.15, diesel to RM3.04 - paultan.org
n53ee73a944.summary: Malaysia's weekly fuel price update for February 26 to March 4, 2026 raises prices by 5 sen, with RON95 at RM2.59, RON97 at RM3.15 and diesel at RM3.04.
n53ee73a944.why: Domestic fuel prices feed into transport costs, inflation and government subsidy spending in Malaysia.

nb61e06f5b9.headline: Stock market today: Which are top gainers and losers on NSE and BSE on February 25? Check list
nb61e06f5b9.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended marginally higher on Wednesday after a volatile session, as profit-booking wiped out most of the day's gains.
nb61e06f5b9.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities, tracking large listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

n820b62136d.headline: Nvidia heads into results with the numbers almost certain to impress. The question is whether that still moves the stock
n820b62136d.summary: Nvidia reports fourth-quarter results after the market closes on Wednesday. Wedbush Securities questions when investor sentiment will shift, while maintaining its view on the stock.
n820b62136d.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI graphics processors, so its results and guidance are closely watched across technology markets.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Quarterly results and outlook directly determine the company's reported performance and investor reaction.

n641c4e2096.headline: TOP scales import via Singapore trading
n641c4e2096.summary: Top Line Business Development Corp. is setting up a wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore to improve fuel supply reliability and optimise costs as it scales imports.
n641c4e2096.why: Fuel trading hubs such as Singapore are central to regional oil supply, so trading subsidiaries there affect how companies source and price fuel.

n3306a9edd3.headline: Transalloys warns 600 jobs at risk without electricity tariff relief
n3306a9edd3.summary: Transalloys has warned that 600 jobs are at risk without electricity tariff relief. A proposed tariff of 62c per kilowatt-hour could offer temporary breathing space.
n3306a9edd3.why: Electricity is a major input cost for ferroalloy smelters, so tariff levels directly affect the viability and employment of energy-intensive producers.

ncd0ec84d59.headline: NC Commerce cancels six JDIG projects
ncd0ec84d59.summary: North Carolina Commerce has cancelled six Job Development Investment Grant projects. A John Locke Foundation analyst noted that almost half of JDIG awards in fiscal 2003–25 failed to meet job targets.
ncd0ec84d59.why: Job Development Investment Grants are state incentives that reward companies for creating jobs, so cancellations signal how public economic subsidies are being managed.

ne4cc5fab06.headline: Nvidia and other tech stocks lead Wall Street higher
ne4cc5fab06.summary: US stocks rose and erased their losses for the week so far. Nvidia and other technology companies led the advance on Wall Street.
ne4cc5fab06.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its share moves often set the tone for the technology sector and broader US equity indices.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia was named as leading the advance in technology shares.

ne4cc5fab06.why_moved: Nvidia and other technology companies led the gains, pushing US stocks higher after an earlier weekly decline.

n8ca515f5cb.headline: SK On signs 25,000-ton lithium supply deal with Posco
n8ca515f5cb.summary: SK On has signed a supply deal with Posco Holdings to secure up to 25,000 tons of lithium. The agreement advances SK On's efforts to diversify its battery raw material sourcing.
n8ca515f5cb.why: SK On is a South Korean battery maker, and securing lithium supply is critical for electric vehicle battery production costs and continuity.

nbbf54cbc4d.headline: Alliance Bank posts record quarterly net profit of RM215.22mil in 3Q
nbbf54cbc4d.summary: Alliance Bank Malaysia reported its highest quarterly net profit of RM215.22 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. The figure is up 15.3% year on year.
nbbf54cbc4d.why: Alliance Bank is a Malaysian commercial lender, and its quarterly profits indicate the health of domestic banking and lending demand.

n9c99413a69.headline: SSI ceasing operations of Marks & Spencer
n9c99413a69.summary: Listed retailer SSI Group, through subsidiary Stores Specialists Inc., will stop operating Marks & Spencer in the Philippines by May.
n9c99413a69.why: SSI Group is a Philippine listed retailer that runs international brands under licence, so changes in its brand portfolio affect its revenue base.

n22d52f2cb0.headline: As data centers multiply, localization pushed
n22d52f2cb0.summary: Philippine data center capacity is projected to triple to nearly 500 megawatts by 2028, with the country positioned as a potential Southeast Asian digital hub.
n22d52f2cb0.why: Data centers host cloud and AI workloads, so their power capacity and location drive investment in digital infrastructure and energy demand.
